top_signals.title: Stocks Fluctuate on Anthropic, Aussie Dollar Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and US equity-index futures diverged after Anthropic PBC priced its initial public offering, putting investor appetite for the technology sector to a fresh test after global equities slid to their weakest level since April. The Australian dollar fell.
